lab_questions.title: Data Privacy & PII Masking
lab_questions.description: Evaluate a candidate's ability to implement secure, role-based data masking directly inside DRF serializers, enforce tenant-level access controls, and maintain compliance audit trails.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Dynamic Serializer Representation
tasks.description:
The `GET /api/patients/{id}/` returns the patient's full Social Security Number (SSN) to all staff.

**Goal:** Modify the DRF Serializer to dynamically mask the SSN (e.g., `***-**-1234`) using `to_representation()` if the `request.user.role` is not 'DOCTOR' or 'ADMIN'.

tasks.title: Record-Level Access Control
tasks.description:
Doctors are currently able to query and view medical records for patients that are not assigned to them.

**Goal:** Update `PatientDetailView.get_queryset()` to filter the queryset. If the user's role is `DOCTOR`, they must only be able to retrieve patients where `assigned_doctor == request.user`. Other roles (like `ADMIN` or `RECEPTIONIST`) should retain access to all patients. If a doctor accesses a patient not assigned to them, DRF should naturally return a `404 Not Found`.

tasks.title: HIPAA Audit Logging
tasks.description:
HIPAA compliance requires an audit trail whenever highly sensitive patient data is accessed.

**Goal:** Create an `AuditLog` model mapping a `user` to a `patient`. Override the `retrieve` method in `PatientDetailView` so that whenever a patient record is successfully fetched, a new `AuditLog` entry is created in the database recording who accessed it.
